recommendations.title: Relaunch with High-Efficiency 'Xpander' Offer
recommendations.detail: Immediately relaunch a new campaign using the 'Xpander GLX AT | Low DP' offer. This specific ad outperformed the campaign average by 62%, achieving a cost per message of $32.54 versus the campaign's $87.27. Use the 'OUTCOME_SALES' objective optimized for Messenger.

recommendations.title: Deploy Top-Performing 'LEGIT SURE' Creative
recommendations.detail: Utilize the 'LEGIT SURE 100%' creative asset (ID 120208137194060625) as the primary visual. With 318 messages and a $29.18 CPA historically, it is your most stable asset. Avoid testing new unproven creatives until a baseline lead flow is established.

recommendations.title: Scale proven 'Metro South' Audience
recommendations.detail: Focus the initial relaunch budget on the 'Metro South' region within the 25–55 age bracket. This segment produced a high CTR of 8.22%, indicating strong product-market fit for the current car models.

recommendations.title: Audit and Reduce CPM Leakage
recommendations.detail: The July campaign saw CPMs spike to $355.78, while the top creative historically ran at $207.53. When relaunching, monitor the first 48 hours; if CPM exceeds $250, shift from 'Sales' objective to 'Engagement (Messenger)' to lower entry costs while maintaining lead quality.
